# Diceri

> Diceri is a video-call app with live voice translation, an open-source alternative to
> Google Meet where you talk and listen in your own language. Everyone in the meeting hears
> your voice in their language, a moment later, with live captions alongside.

Each account (username and password, no email) owns one room at `https://diceri.com/@username`.
Guests join from that link without an account; the host decides whether they walk in or ask
first. Each listener picks the language they want to hear. The free plan includes 60 call
minutes a month. Rooms are private: they are not listed and an agent cannot join a call.

## Docs

- [What Diceri is](https://diceri.com/index.md): the home page as Markdown
- [Architecture](https://github.com/julianosig/diceri.com/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): how calls, translation and accounts fit together
- [Decisions](https://github.com/julianosig/diceri.com/blob/main/docs/decisions/): why each provider and protocol was chosen
- [Data inventory](https://github.com/julianosig/diceri.com/blob/main/docs/data-inventory.md): what personal data is kept, why and for how long

## API

- [API catalog](https://diceri.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset for the HTTP API
- [Capabilities](https://diceri.com/api/v1/capabilities): what this deployment offers, as JSON
